description_expanded: The Point - Oceanfront Home in Blue Mountain Beach with Direct Beach Access Favorite Features: - Gulf-Front - Private Beach Boardwalk - Grill Area - Firepit More About The Point: Located directly on the pristine beaches of 30A, you can’t beat The Point’s phenomenal location. This Blue Mountain Beach vacation home features panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico, five bedrooms, and plenty of space for entertaining. The Point can accommodate up to seventeen guests comfortably, which makes this enormous one-story beach house the ideal place to host a family trip or reunion.  Inside, this recently remodeled Old-Florida style beach house features views that will take your breath away. The home features two living rooms, which makes entertaining a breeze. The first living room has a sleeper sofa, two armchairs, a wet bar, flatscreen TV, and a huge selection of books you can enjoy while on vacation. This media den flows into the recently updated gourmet kitchen. The kitchen features a sweeping gulf view, luxurious travertine floors, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a breakfast bar seating three, and all the additional kitchen accessories you could ask for including a toaster oven, Keurig, and coffee maker. Next to the kitchen, you’ll find a dining area that features a view of the Gulf, a cozy fireplace and a large formal dining table that seats ten people. The main living space is located next to the kitchen and dining area and overlooks the beach. With a large leather sectional, two armchairs, a flatscreen TV, and an additional dining table seating four, it’s easy to see why this home is perfect for hosting groups. In addition to the main living area’s endless entertainment options, The Point also has plenty of sleeping accommodations for a large group. The master suite is fit for royalty with a spectacular gulf view, king bed, desk, flatscreen TV, sitting area, and two bathrooms. The first bathroom in the master is the main master bathroom and includes a dual sink vanity, claw foot bathtub, walk-in shower, gulf views, and a gigantic walk-in closet. The second attached bathroom also opens up to the hall for other guests to use as well and includes a dual sink vanity and a walk-in shower with bench seating.  The Point features four more bedrooms in addition to the master suite. The second bedroom features a twin/full bunk bed and the third bedroom has a queen bed, twin/twin bunk bed, and a flatscreen TV. Both bedrooms are located near the master bedroom’s second attached bathroom that they can use. On the other side of the home, you’ll find the remaining two bedrooms. The fourth bedroom includes an amazing gulf view, a queen bed, a twin bed, and a flatscreen TV. Next door, the fifth bedroom features a gulf view as well, along with a king bed, flatscreen TV, and an ensuite bathroom that includes a walk-in shower and walk-in closet. Finally, there’s another full bathroom in the hallway that features a walk-in shower as well.  The Point’s outdoor area is what truly makes this home one-of-a-kind. Outside, you’ll find a gigantic wooden deck overlooking the Gulf of Mexico complete with al-fresco dining, lounge chairs, bench seating, and private beach access. The home also features a charming garden patio that includes a grill and firepit as well.  Overall, with breathtaking gulf views throughout the property, a recently renovated interior, and tons of space for entertaining, The Point truly stands out from the crowd. If you’re looking for a spectacular gulf-front home in Blue Mountain Beach that’s perfect for groups, The Point is sure to impress. **Fireplaces are a seasonal feature that can only be utilized from October through April. Fireplaces will not be in working order from May to September. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed, Twin Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Twin over Twin Bunk & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: Twin over Full Bunk & Shared Bathroom with Shower.  Additional Arrangements: Sleeper Sofa
